title: 54th sitting of the 20th Majlis

items.text: Opening recitation (Hamd and Salawat); the sitting begins.
Roll call of members present at the sitting.
Announcement of the day's agenda (Agenda No. އޖ/54/2024).
Preliminary debate on the Bill amending the Maldives Sports Act (Law No. 30/2015), submitted on behalf of the government by Dhidhdhoo MP Abdul Latheef Mohamed.
Continued debate on the Budget Committee's report on its review of the proposed State Budget for 2025.
Voting on items from the day's business that have reached the voting stage.

summary: The sitting opened debate on a government bill amending the Sports Act and continued debating the Budget Committee's report on the 2025 State Budget.
